name: Gold Trend & Pullback
description: Trend-following dip-buying strategy tuned to 4 years of XAU/USD daily data (Sep 2022 - Sep 2026). Gold spent ~75% of days above the 200 EMA with a median daily range of ~1.3%, and RSI dips below 35 were followed by +0.85% average 5-day bounces vs +0.33% in the neutral zone. Core idea: buy EMA-21 touches and RSI-oversold dips while price is above the 200 EMA (regime gate), confirm momentum with MACD, and only short when the 200-EMA regime breaks. SL is ATR-scaled per timeframe (H1: 1.5x ATR / 3.5x ATR).
